correctionAndBoundaryPassages.text: All machine date-time values use RFC 3339 strings. Instants use UTC with uppercase Z and exactly three fractional-second digits. Date-only values use YYYY-MM-DD and are never coerced to an instant. Leap-second values are rejected. Offset-bearing input may be accepted only at an external boundary and is normalized to UTC while preserving the original value as evidence.

Every stage operation that can produce a DATA_PROPOSAL declares exactly one acceptance mode in the STAGE_OPERATION_REGISTRY:
- HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED: the validated pending proposal commits only after explicit operator acceptance through REVIEW_PROPOSAL or REVIEW_FILE_RESPONSE_PROPOSAL;
- VALIDATED_AUTO_COMMIT: the validated proposal commits without operator review.

HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED is the default mode and is mandatory for Stage 01 COMPLETE and RECONCILE_INTAKE, wherever the proposal co-accepts a humanAuthorityCandidates confirmation under Section 14.10, and wherever the accepted result supersedes previously accepted current canonical records under a REPLACE_CURRENT_STAGE_SET policy. VALIDATED_AUTO_COMMIT is permitted only where the operation writes exclusively agent-owned fields into its own reserved target slot, carries no humanAuthorityCandidates, and embeds no genuine human-authority decision. Application commands never use proposal acceptance; they commit directly under Sections 22.4 and 36.12. The declared mode is closed and version-bound and cannot be altered by a response.

For SAVE_HUMAN_INPUT, an absent/null/empty-string answer, or an empty MULTI_CHOICE array, is unanswered; a blocking request rejects it. A nonmissing TEXT or LONG_TEXT answer is a nonblank string; BOOLEAN is Boolean; NUMBER is either a JSON safe integer other than negative zero, or a string rational:N/D where N is a nonzero signed base-10 integer with no plus or leading zeros, D is a positive base-10 integer with no leading zeros, and gcd(abs(N),D)=1. D=1 is permitted only when N is outside the JSON safe-integer range. Zero is represented only by JSON integer 0. Other strings and typed objects are rejected; saving preserves this canonical representation; CHOICE is one exact allowed string; MULTI_CHOICE is an ordered duplicate-free array of exact allowed strings; DATE is a valid Gregorian calendar date in four-digit YYYY-MM-DD form with year 0001–9999, validated without time-zone conversion; FILE_REFERENCE is one current canonical artifact ID in the same project. Optional unanswered requests confer no factual assertion. Successful saving has precisely the existing §18 invalidation and replacement consequences.

For the conditional native route of 07 EXECUTE_FAILURE_TEST, 15 EXECUTE_REGRESSION, 19 REGRESSION_VERIFY, and the 38 F1 pairs, the input-binding minimum is APPLICATION_OBSERVED. The application establishes that basis from actual custody and verification of each required exact input, its current identity/hash and scope, before execution may start. This is not a requirement that execution has already succeeded: execution outcome, isolation, provenance, disposition and evidence sufficiency are separately determined from the actual execution. An absent or mismatched required input blocks native execution; a download, actor echo or route label does not satisfy this native minimum. This clause does not change the execution mode or permit an unapproved fallback to a different executor. Existing application, human-decision and operator commands outside these conditional pairs retain their existing source contracts; no external evidence minimum is assigned to them by this amendment.

For an external route, exact attributable echoes of the application-issued package/manifest identity and each required member identity/digest may establish EXTERNALLY_SUPPORTED under the existing input-binding contract; missing or mismatched echoes cannot. A package download, filename, provider label or unbound assertion is insufficient. Echoes never become APPLICATION_OBSERVED external possession, VERIFIED_EXTERNAL attestation, or proof of hidden provider independence. Recording that the application supplied bytes does not prove that an external recipient independently possessed or executed them.

If the applicable proof obligation, evidence contract or dimensioned-independence contract requires a stronger or distinct basis, that requirement also must be met. This generic minimum cannot weaken it, convert SUPPORTS_ONLY into ESTABLISHES, remove a required accepted review, waive unknown freshness/independence, or supply a successful result. §29.14's registered attestation-verification contract remains necessary for VERIFIED_EXTERNAL. Actual basis and its supporting observations remain recorded and evaluated by the existing gates.
